text: Good afternoon, I am Inspector Rathore from the Delhi Crime Branch. A package in your name with fake passports was intercepted. Pay the verification amount of 30,000 or we will register a case and arrest you.
Blue Dart here. Your consignment was stopped by customs for contraband. Clear the penalty of 7,999 right away otherwise a police complaint will be lodged.
Your SIM card will be blocked in 2 hours due to KYC non-compliance. Give me the OTP sent to your number to verify.
This call is from the Cyber Crime cell. Stay on the line and keep this between us; your bank account is linked to money laundering.
Pay 2,000 as a refundable registration fee to get the work-from-home job. Send it to my UPI and share the screenshot.
We are from the FedEx legal department. A parcel with drugs was booked using your Aadhaar. You will be arrested unless you pay the settlement amount today.
Your PAN card is blocked. Update now by clicking this link and entering your card number, CVV and PIN.
Ma'am, scan this QR code to receive your refund of 4,500. Enter your UPI PIN to complete the transaction now.
I am calling from customs at Mumbai airport. Your gift parcel from London contains foreign currency. Pay the customs clearance charge of 45,000 immediately.
Your Netflix subscription has been suspended. Verify your card details within 24 hours to avoid termination.
Your FedEx shipment 7781 is in transit and will arrive on Friday. Track it on fedex.com.
Customs duty of Rs 1,180 is payable on your DHL import shipment. Pay on the DHL website or to the courier at delivery.
Reminder: your car insurance renewal is due next week. Visit our nearest branch or renew in the app.
Mumbai Police: beware of callers claiming to be from customs or FedEx. Police never demand money over the phone.
Your traffic challan has been paid successfully. Thank you. -Parivahan
Hi, it's Rahul. Running 10 minutes late, order the starters without me.
Your Airtel bill of Rs 599 is generated. Pay by the due date to avoid a late fee.
Thank you for visiting the branch today. Your fixed deposit has been opened.
Your account statement for September is ready. Log in to net banking to view it.
Dear parent, school fees for term 2 are due by 30 Oct. Pay at the school office or online.
